name: Zoom Platform Studio
desc: Single developer portal for Zoom AI Services, Video SDK and Co-Browse.
desc_zh: 把 Zoom AI Services、Video SDK 和 Co-Browse 收进一个开发者门户
solves: Zoom's APIs and SDKs were spread across several sites with separate accounts. Platform Studio puts keys, docs and tooling in one place to start building.
solves_zh: Zoom 的 API 和 SDK 过去散落在几个站点，账号也要分别申请。Platform Studio 把密钥、文档和工具集中到一处，直接开工。
best_for: You are wiring Zoom's voice AI into your own app and do not know where the keys live.
best_for_zh: 你要把 Zoom 的语音 AI 接进自己的应用，却不知道该去哪里申请密钥。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.zoom.com/en/products/whats-new/ (product timeline, October 2026)）。 Announced at Zoomtopia on 2026-10-20 as the common entry point for Zoom's developer platform. The newsroom post also lists the Zoom AI Services API expansion (15 new services including Voice Agent APIs, Interpreter API, Speech Summarization API and Decisions API) in the same announcement; those APIs are recorded as part of Zoom AI Services rather than separate cards. No media source was read. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：官方名字「Platform Studio」是通用词，带上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://news.zoom.com/zoomtopia-2026-developer
